description: This Kotlin source file defines the AppInstallManager class, which manages app installation processes including installation, cancellation, user confirmation, and notification updates within an Android environment. It handles app states, pre-approvals, downloads, and interactions with system services.

classes.name: AppInstallManager
classes.description: Manages app installation lifecycle, including starting, tracking, user confirmation, and notification updates.

methods.name: getAppFlow
methods.description: Returns a flow of installation states for a specific app package.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a specified app version, handling pre-approval and state tracking.

methods.name: setWaitingState
methods.description: Sets the app state to waiting with provided details.

methods.name: startInstall
methods.description: Begins the installation process, including pre-approval and download.

methods.name: trackJob
methods.description: Tracks and manages the lifecycle of an installation job.

methods.name: requestPreApprovalConfirmation
methods.description: Requests user confirmation for pre-approval and proceeds based on response.

methods.name: downloadAndInstall
methods.description: Handles downloading the app file and installing it, managing progress updates.

methods.name: requestUserConfirmation
methods.description: Requests user confirmation for installation and waits for response.

methods.name: checkUserConfirmation
methods.description: Checks and re-prompts user confirmation if needed, especially on Android 10-13.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing installation job for a package.

methods.name: onUninstallResult
methods.description: Handles the result of an uninstall activity, updating state and logging.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up app state and cancels ongoing jobs for a package.

methods.name: onStatesUpdated
methods.description: Updates notifications and foreground service based on current app installation states.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves app icon either from cache or by downloading.

methods.name: updateApp
methods.description: Updates the installation state of an app in the internal state flow.

methods.name: checkAndUpdateApp
methods.description: Checks and updates the app state, ensuring it is of type InstallStateWithInfo.
